notes.title: MacOS joins major update v1.2 - now live on Steam!
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We're having fun out here and hope you are as well.

Major update (v1.2) is now live on MacOS version of the game on Steam!

Quick recap of the key updates in this version:
- New wheelie trick
- Star tier scoring system
- New crash animation
- More Steam achievements added
- More SFX added
- Range of UX enhancements
- Range of gameplay tuning across levels
- Range of bug fixes

Hope you enjoy and until next time!

Cheers,
Joel

notes.title: v1.2, Build 17 minor patch
notes.content: Patch contains minor visual bug fixes (e.g. misalignment of blank stars) and some menu button navigation fixes.

notes.title: Big News - BMX Gravel Major Update Goes Live!
notes.content:

notes.title: Upcoming Major Version Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822156/fdda21bc0e4fd05237c13854b24761d7cfe340ef.png[/img]

Hi folks,

Hope you are having fun out there. I know we are!

Thrilled to annouce we are planning a major update for BMX Gravel over the next couple of months.

We are also attempting to crowdfund the work through campaigns on Kickstarter and Indiegogo (links below). This is the first time we have used these platforms for anything, let alone funding for an indie game, so no doubt will turn into a number of teachable moments for us! 

If by any chance you would like to be an active part of the "movement" and support us we will both love you forever and there are some nice rewards on offer if you want to up your ante such as your name forever immortalised in game credits / game website, voting rights on features to be included in this next update and even sweet special limited edition merch (some of which is signed), so once we make it big you can take it to eBay later and sell it for millions! ;D

Crowdfunding campaigns:
[list]
[*] Kickstarter: https://kck.st/4aXPx0e
[*] Indiegogo: https://bit.ly/3UjJ88A
[/list]

All the very best and until next time.

Cheers,
Joel

notes.title: Steam Achievements, Cloud Save and Leaderboards added!
notes.content:
Hi all,

We're having fun out there.

[b]Steam integration features[/b] come to BMX Gravel in this latest version v1.1 (Build 15) across Windows and MacOS!

Including:

[list]
[*] [b]Steam Achievements: [/b]Rewarded at various unlock points throughout the game based on various criteria
[*] [b]Steam Cloud:[/b] So your save games and personal high scores can come with you whereever you may want to go
[*] [b]Three New Global Steam Leaderboards:[/b] One per difficulty level so you can compete with the wider Steam community to see who truly is the Ultimate BMX Gravel Master.
[/list]
Til next time!

Cheers,
Joel
